# PLAN — iteration 1
## Current state assessment
The baseline passes the frozen simulation and uses 388 LUTs, 325 FFs, 7 DSP48s, and no BRAM, but it fails setup at WNS −11.741 ns; hold passes at WHS +0.103 ns. The reported critical path runs from history through a multiplier, a serial accumulation tree, rounding, and saturation to `data1`, with 23 logic levels. Timing closure is the first objective; any candidate must also preserve the five-slot elastic behavior, minimum accepted-transfer age of five cycles, arithmetic results, reset, and handshakes.

## Hypothesis
Move the FIR arithmetic into the existing elastic slots so each register-to-register path handles only one bounded arithmetic stage, which should reduce logic depth and improve setup slack at the cost of additional FFs and possibly LUTs.

## Instruction for generator
Keep the history update and five-slot ready/valid behavior, but replace the current combinational `acc_wide` through `fir_result` path feeding `data1` with arithmetic payloads carried through the existing slots. Capture the eight 17-bit symmetric pair sums in slot 1, compute and register the eight signed products in slot 2, form two balanced four-product partial sums in slot 3, and combine and round in slot 4; perform the existing signed saturation in slot 5. Preserve signed widths sufficient for exact products and the 28-bit accumulator, hold each payload whenever its slot is stalled, and keep the top-level `// @latency 5` annotation and all observable cycle behavior unchanged.
